explication: BigBlueButton is a virtual classroom. Teachers and learners enter a meeting, authenticate a session, and receive real-time classroom state and media through specialized meeting applications; the web client then renders layouts and synchronizes audio state. The repository also supports presentation conversion/downloads, recording-oriented state, callbacks, plugins, breakout rooms, collaboration tools, and analytics. Sampled code confirms session-to-meeting lookup, Redis persistence, presentation processing, callback retries, and client rendering/state synchronization; several application dispatch links remain unsampled.
